answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 42 identities per epoch. Audits are published in river, queued in trellis, and crystal publishes the wait time. A farm of 55 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4899 identities would post 2809 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
